description: This file defines the SeoUrl class within the Opencart e-commerce platform, specifically handling URL rewriting and parsing for SEO-friendly URLs. It includes methods for processing incoming URL requests and generating SEO URLs from query parameters, utilizing regex patterns and model interactions.

classes.name: SeoUrl
classes.description: Handles SEO URL rewriting and decoding for the Opencart platform.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Processes incoming URLs to decode SEO-friendly URLs into operational query parameters.

methods.name: rewrite
methods.description: Converts standard URLs with query parameters into SEO-friendly URL paths.
